scope: Preauthorized global16 additional contrast, lowrank only, three seeds, same data/loss/steps; primary45 retained

data.observation_mixing: fixed dense orthogonal matrix shared across conditions

training.loss: one-step MSE + 0.5 times mean free-running horizon-1..5 MSE, divided by training-only global delta variance scalar
training.checkpoint_selection: last step; dev diagnostics do not select checkpoint

evaluation.normalization: training-only per-condition delta energy, floored at 1e-6
evaluation.latency_scope: initial coordinate transform + native transformed rollout + final reconstruction; separately report each-step reconstruction required by an original-coordinate interface
evaluation.summary_unit: episode and training seed, never independent frames or candidate rows

action_response_design.normalization: train delta energy; additionally report true response energy normalized diagnostic
action_response_design.perturbation: four seeded Rademacher directions per episode, symmetric plus/minus 0.1 per element

gates.communication_effect: global4 must beat local4 on held-out lowrank-coupled episode-paired errors consistently across seeds; otherwise inconclusive or NO-GO
gates.representation_effect: learned_block vs random_block on held-out independent episode-paired errors

continuation.global16: activated by primary lowrank dev: global4 better than local4 and learned_block in all seeds; no further expansion

compute.login_node: connection, submission, status, and small control-file operations only
compute.guard: require real PBS_JOBID, PBS_NODEFILE membership, non-login hostname

primary_reference.parameters: global16 adds parameters; bandwidth and capacity not isolated
